description: A single full-body FRONT orthographic character design reference, eye-level with NO top-down perspective. Young adult Asian woman, calm observant neutral expression, believable natural adult anatomy, about seven-and-a-half heads tall, modest slim average build, NOT chibi or super-deformed. Standing straight and symmetrical, feet slightly apart facing forward, arms held about twenty degrees from torso in a relaxed low A-pose, palms inward; entire head, hands and bare feet visible with margins. Deep charcoal black loose long hair to mid-back, a few clear front locks, face visible. Wears only a SIMPLE standardized white cryogenic sleep gown, not a doctor lab coat: closed plain round neckline, loose full-length sleeves to wrists, straight softly hanging calf-length fabric, comfortable unstructured fit. No collar lapels, belt, buttons, zipper, straps, pockets, jewellery, armor, machinery or accessories. Modest opaque clothing; no cleavage or exposed shoulders. Fabric matte off-white with cool light gray folds and subtle desaturated gray storage aging on cuffs, neckline and hem; gentle long-storage creases, intact preserved garment, no conspicuous dirt, no yellowing, holes, blood, mildew or heavy damage. Detailed clean hand-crafted pixel-art design language, coherent small pixel clusters, readable restrained flat shading that explains volume without shiny gradients. Natural expressive human face, no giant anime eyes. Soft even neutral studio illumination, no cast shadow, no environment, no text, no labels, no extra views, no grid. Transparent background. This is a clear MODELING design reference, not a tiny game sprite.
